text: Day thirty-one. You've missed a full E M I, and your loan gets a label. S M A one. Special Mention Account. Every two weeks, lenders send updates to credit bureaus like CIBIL. So now your report shows it. And your score starts to fall. That new phone on no-cost E M I? Rejected. The credit card upgrade? Rejected. And that record... is kept for at least seven years. {warm} Quick pause. If this is your life right now... breathe. Almost everything you'll see next can still be stopped. Especially if you act early. {neutral} So tell me in the comments: if your E M I bounced tomorrow... who would you call first?
